slice: Windows dependency graph, third-party licence/NOTICE consistency, runtime dependency survey
product_source: 87922dd567187bec88186944247d1f5644ba2a1b (unchanged by this slice: no product, verification code or NOTICE change was needed)

a_windows_dependency_graph.command: cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --filter-platform x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, then a normal+build traversal from the cos-desktop binary

edge_kinds_separated.dev_only: excluded by construction — the traversal follows normal and build edges only

a_windows_dependency_graph.pinned: Cargo.lock and the GPUI git revision are unchanged
a_windows_dependency_graph.note: 369 is the exact population of this traversal (the earlier 368 dropped one package). It is the build-time dependency closure, not a proof of what is linked into the executable; dev-only edges are excluded by construction.

b_third_party_licences.why_the_16_matter: a declared SPDX expression is not the licence text; whether a distribution must carry each text depends on the licence and on what the package ships, so their text has to be collected and assessed before any package leaves the internal stage

notice_files_found_in_fetched_sources.content: carries an MIT permission notice for code derived from tectonic_cfg_support::target_cfg!, and cfg_aliases declares MIT
notice_files_found_in_fetched_sources.obligation_state: OPEN — whether that notice must accompany the distribution depends on MIT attribution practice and on whether the crate is linked; it is not an Apache-2.0 §4(d) obligation

unicode.existing_notice_entry: the repository NOTICE already names Unicode 16.0.0 simple case-folding data and points at the generated file

b_third_party_licences.not_a_legal_conclusion: this record lists declared expressions, text presence and one NOTICE file. It does not decide whether any obligation is met, nor which licence applies to a combined work.

licence_text_by_source.pinned_zed_git: 17 crates from one pinned revision; the checkout carries LICENSE-APACHE, individual crate texts were not opened
licence_text_by_source.workspace: 6 local crates, covered by the repository LICENSE/NOTICE

b_third_party_licences.declared_expression_wording: all 369 declare a licence string in Cargo metadata. Nineteen of those strings (MIT/Apache-2.0 x14, Apache-2.0/MIT x5) are not well-formed SPDX expressions; they are recorded verbatim rather than rewritten, and they are counted as licence strings, not as SPDX expressions.

c_runtime_dependencies.starting_point: the published binary-survey.json for the staged executable (34 direct import labels, x86_64, unsigned, delay-import directory zero)

classes_separated.system_dlls: KERNEL32, USER32, GDI32, ntdll, bcryptprimitives, USERENV and the api-ms-win-* API sets observed directly
classes_separated.redistributable_candidates: VCRUNTIME140 and the api-ms-win-crt-* set — the MSVC runtime, whose redistribution terms are not decided here
classes_separated.delay_load: NOT_INSPECTED — the delay-import directory is zero in the observed image
classes_separated.transitive_or_dynamic: NOT_MEASURED — a direct-import list cannot prove closure

claims_not_made: no permissive claim for the MSVC runtime

d_notice_consistency.current_notice: names Apache-2.0 for COS Desktop and the Unicode data entry only
d_notice_consistency.finding: every declared dependency uses a permissive family expression. Two questions stay OPEN: the licence texts of the 16 registry packages that ship none in their fetched source, and whether the cfg_aliases MIT notice must be propagated. Neither is decided here, and the repository NOTICE is unchanged.
d_notice_consistency.change_made: none — adding attributions without the licence texts, or shipping a NOTICE that implies compliance, would be worse than stating the gap
d_notice_consistency.decision_needed: before any distribution, collect and assess the missing texts and decide how obligations are satisfied. That can be done inside the existing LICENSE/NOTICE files or may need more files; which one is a distribution decision, not something this survey establishes.

commands_run: source scan of ~/.cargo/registry/src for licence and NOTICE files among the 346 registry packages
verification.package_suite: 28 tests collected, 27 passed, 1 skipped (Windows denies symbolic-link creation); the four-file allowlist and unsigned refusal are unchanged
verification.gate: none — no product or verification code changed (ADR-0014 Y04)

open_items: licence texts for the 16 registry packages that ship none in their fetched source
whether the cfg_aliases MIT notice must accompany the distribution
MSVC runtime redistribution terms and whether the package must supply it
transitive and dynamically loaded DLL closure
how the obligations are satisfied (existing files or a wider package set) — a distribution decision
DD-21 signing, publisher, installer, channel and uninstall policy
scope_note: Inner staging, signing, licence compliance and distribution acceptance are reported separately: staging is limited-complete, signing/installer remain DD-21 OPEN, licence obligations remain OPEN as listed, and no product acceptance is claimed.
